_help: Problems the every-size check (node tools/check-style-sizes.mjs, model/style-check.js) finds in today's standard buildings that are kept on purpose. Each line turns exactly that problem into a warning, with its reason; any problem NOT listed here fails the check. A line that no longer matches anything also fails, so take it out when the building is fixed. Add a line only with a reason a person can read. Fields: styles (the library style codes; a style of a business's own is matched by the style it is built like), sizes (leave out for every size), variants (leave out for every variant), code and id (exactly as the check prints them), reason.
